newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil recaptures killer of Amazon forest champion.
newsitem.headline: Brazil recaptures killer of Amazon forest champion.

text.p: Brazilian police recaptured one of the convicted murderers of Amazon rubber-tapper leader and rainforest champion Chico Mendes on Monday, police said.

Darci Alves had been on the run since escaping from jail in 1993 along with his father Darli Alves, who was also convicted of the 1988 slaying of Mendes, a world-famous figure in the fight to save the Amazon forest.

Darci, who confessed during his trial to firing the shots that killed Mendes, was arrested as he left the house of a relative in Guaira, in the southern state of Parana, a spokeswoman for Brazil's federal police said.
His father was recaptured in July when police raided a remote farm in the northern state of Para, but Darci managed to avoid arrest on that occasion.
The two men -- who were sentenced to 19 years each for the murder of Mendes -- will be held at a prison in Brasilia, the spokeswoman said.
In October, Darli won a court-ordered transfer to the delapidated jail from which he and his son escaped. They will only return there once the prison has been made secure, she said.
